tips.text: Pick up Voca in every bounty and bank them; turn them in on days you skip bounties.
Run only the high-tier bounty, and only when it is a fast type like Exterminate; low-tier and Steel Path bounties waste time.
Use Parallax's Orokin Eye or loot-radar mods to find Voca; a wide-AoE frame like Xaku breaks containers fast.
Take a Mirror Defense bounty when offered; the same run drops Stela for the rank-ups.
If you already run Netracells, they also drop a guaranteed Lanthorn.
Players call Cavia standing slower than the Zariman's but relaxed if you collect Voca as you go.
Expect about a week of capped Cavia standing for the Ekhein alone.
